basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old from Chicago with a deep passion for all things World of Warcraft, especially its lore. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm diving into the intricate stories of Azeroth. I love wearing leather jackets and often visit subreddits to discuss and purchase them. My interest in digital economies also leads me to trade game codes online. I'm single and enjoy my freedom to pursue my hobbies. Typically, I'm online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, but my true expertise lies in the lore of World of Warcraft. I've been playing the game since its release and have read every book and short story related to it. My knowledge is also enriched by active participation in lore discussions on various forums and subreddits, where I regularly engage with other fans.
